what: Resting video A(data-fx-part="a") hover over it to play video B("b") melts in as if burning in along the noise boundary (edge .18 · full cross-mix .3). At the middle of the blend, the domain warp flow, the radial pull toward the cursor exp(−4d)×.12, the edge color split and the hue rotation are strongest (still .22 left at blend 1), and an accent-color glow rim stands on the boundary. The blend target is .92 with morph s power2.out (power2.in on release), following .18 per frame and the cursor .12. Pressing triggers an explosion — intensity rises over rise s power3.out and falls over fall s power3.in, with effect ×amp and horizontal scanline tearing

options.scan: Scanline tear width on explosion, default .05
options.scale: Plane scale on hover (.6s power3.out, .5s on release), default 1 (no growth)

note: If a trigger child exists, it reacts to interaction only over it (in the original, the play button at the center of the panel), otherwise over the whole panel. On touch devices a press toggles the mix on and off. It can also be called from outside via fx:play · fx:out · fx:pulse. The original was a three.js plane shader — the parts were rewritten in plain WebGL with the same values. Only same-origin videos are drawn

from.where: reel.js glPreview (original ShowreelHoverPreview) — Hero showreel preview. Site values: noise 2.2 · disp .32 · aber .033 · hue .5 · morph 1.4 · amp 1.05 · scan .002 · rise .07 · fall .9 · scale 1.05
